about: Breaks a siege of one of your castles or towns: it waits where it is until strong enough, then strikes the besiegers (the garrison joins the battle). Best with an army, for example gather, then relieve.
calls_back: it strikes, it is still too weak to strike, the siege ends, or the holding falls

strike_at: strike when its strength is this many times the besiegers'
wait_hours: how long to wait for enough strength before giving up

when.poke: {me} is striking the besiegers of {at}: strength {strength} against {siege_strength(at)}.
{me} is too weak to strike the besiegers of {at} yet: strength {strength} against {siege_strength(at)}.

wait.about: waiting for the strength to relieve {at}

when.poke: {me} is striking the besiegers of {at}: strength {strength} against {siege_strength(at)}.
{me} waited {wait_hours} hours without the strength to relieve {at}.
